messages:
sarah-chen: Quick async update — we're targeting the pricing/packaging change merge on Fri. Two blockers: metering adapter integration and contract clause about committed tiers. Need final owners and explicit signoffs.

ajay: I can take metering adapter. ETA EOD Thu for a PR. Any special edge cases? will test prefix caching + dedupe.

mike_w: Thanks @ajay. Push a draft when ready. One thing: quota enforcement behavior when a customer hits reserved capacity vs burst — do we throttle or fail? Current plan in docs is to failover to hosted variant.

jules: For contract language: legal asked to ensure committed-tier discounts apply only post-invoicing. I'll paste the clause they're requesting:

jules: ```
"Committed capacity discounts apply to billed usage during the invoice period following confirmation of the customer's committed capacity; retroactive credits are not applied."
```

jules: Legal wants a short note in the billing API that flags `committed_discount_applied: boolean` on invoices.

ajay: That flag is easy. design note for billing event shape:

ajay: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "C123",
  "invoice": {
    "units": 120000,
    "committed_discount_applied": true
  }
}
```

billing-bot: unit-tests metering-adapter: build #832 passed — integration tests for ratecard mapping ok :white_check_mark:

ops-ryan: For Dedicated customers we need to ensure quota enforcement happens locally (no cross-region billing calls). That implies a small shim in the private control plane — estimated 2 dev days.

sarah-chen: OK — owners recap:
- Metering adapter: @ajay (PR by Thu)
- Billing schema flag + docs: @jules
- Quota enforcement shim for Dedicated: @ops-ryan
- Legal signoff: @jules to track with legal

sarah-chen: If anybody needs to reassign, call it out here. Otherwise I'll open the rollout checklist and tag owners.

mike_w: quick question on rollout checklist: do we have a canary bucket for pricing changes? last time we rolled back quickly because of meter mismatch.

jules: yes, adding canary to checklist — config: 1% of traffic, separate ratecard mapping. I'll add steps and tests.

sarah-chen: Thanks. I'll create the checklist now and ping in the thread when done :thumbsup:
